name: Ōdai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōdai town emblem in green and blue: a green disc with a white and blue swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Ōdai, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 10 January 2006.

features.role: Ōdai town emblem — a green disc with a white and blue swirl
